rows.ARS:
Red blend Miniature.
Registration name: Stars 'n' Stripes
Exhibition name: Stars 'n' Stripes
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ralph S. Moore (United States, 1976).
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1978 as 'Stars 'n' Stripes'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend, stripes. Sweet fragrance. 21 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 4,029 on 29 Mar 1977 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 05/672,742 on 1 Apr 1976
Issued to Ralph S. Moore, Visalia, California.
rows.Notes: Justice Miniature Roses says this rose is one of the classic striped miniatures that made Mr. Moore famous.
